Leona has invited Flora to join the group.
Leona has invited Biscuit to join the group.
Leona has invited Nero to join the group.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Is that everyone?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Leona.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Why did you invite me?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I'm sitting right next to you.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Haha, I guess I invited everyone out of habit.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: You can leave if you want, Nero.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Ugh, so irritating.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I'll go play with Timi then.
What's this group chat for?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I wanted to make sure that you all made it safe and sound,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: so I figured I'd make a group chat.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I asked Biscuit if she had arrived safely,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: but she hasn't replied.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: So I was getting worried!

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: It's nice to see

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: everyone looking out for each other ✿

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: If anything were to happen, we'd have to head up there straight away.
We all made it safe.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Biscuit is beside me,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: eating berries as we speak ✿

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Oh, nice!

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: We'll be heading back to the garden soon ✿

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Take care of yourselves.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: If anything comes up, just send a message in this group chat anytime.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Whoops!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'm so sorry I didn't get back to you sooner! T_T

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: No worries!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Max seems to miss you a lot.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: He's sitting beside me and keeps stealing glances at me, haha.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Tell him that I miss him too!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Haha, I relayed the message.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: His tail is wagging so fast that I can't even see it, haha.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Oh, by the way!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'm eating these berries called Peachberries right now,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: and I really want to share them with you two!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: They're super delicious!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: If we have a chance to go up to the surface together next time, we definitely have to have some!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I can't bring any to the Ark, unfortunately. T_T
Leona doesn't reply.
Are you there, Leona?
There's still no reply.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Seems like she's busy tending to the garden ✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Once Sunflower finishes with her berries,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: we'll start heading back ✿
